achievements.name: Liberation Begins
achievements.detail: Finish the opening march and set out with the Liberation.

achievements.name: Beyond Cornia
achievements.detail: Finish the Cornia main quests that let the Liberation leave for other nations.

achievements.name: Drakenhold Freed
achievements.detail: Finish Drakenhold's main quests and bring that kingdom into the alliance.

achievements.name: Elheim Freed
achievements.detail: Clear Elheim's main story and win that nation to your side.

achievements.name: Bastorias Freed
achievements.detail: Complete Bastorias's main campaign and add its fighters to the Liberation.

achievements.name: Albion Freed
achievements.detail: Finish Albion's main storyline and free that nation.

achievements.name: Town Restored
achievements.detail: Liberate a town and rebuild it so its shops and services return.

achievements.name: Class Promoted
achievements.detail: Spend Honors to promote an ally into a higher class.

achievements.name: Rapport Raised
achievements.detail: Raise an ally's rapport until a new support conversation unlocks.

achievements.name: Coliseum Win
achievements.detail: Win a match in a city's coliseum.

achievements.name: Valor Skill
achievements.detail: Spend Valor on the field map to use a character's Valor skill.

achievements.name: Final Battle
achievements.detail: Win the war's last battle after the five nations stand together.
